hero.sub: Interior planting for businesses and beautifully designed living spaces.
hero.intro: Blad & Vorm designs, installs and maintains interior planting that brings balance, atmosphere and a lasting sense of wellbeing to every space.

inspiratie.kop: Every great space starts with inspiration.
inspiratie.lede: No two interiors are the same. Discover how thoughtfully designed interior planting brings warmth, character and a welcoming atmosphere to offices, reception areas, professional practices and stylish homes.

filosofie.tekst: Every space deserves its own planting concept. That's why we carefully select plants, planters and materials that complement your interior, reflect your organisation and enhance the way people experience the space.
filosofie.fotoAlt: Bright hall with limewash walls and a travertine floor, with one group of plants in ceramic pots by the windows

diensten.kop: Everything you need for a beautifully maintained interior.

kaarten.tekst: We take the time to understand your space, your requirements and the atmosphere you want to create.
Professionally delivered and carefully installed with attention to every detail.
Regular maintenance keeps your interior planting healthy, vibrant and looking its very best.
Whenever required, we replace plants promptly to ensure your interior always looks fresh and welcoming.

werkwijze.railNote: Four steps, one point of contact.
werkwijze.kop: From first conversation to long-term care.

stappen.tekst: We get to know your business, your space and your ideas.
We assess the layout, natural light and opportunities within your interior.
We deliver and install your complete planting concept with care and precision.
Regular professional maintenance keeps your planting looking beautiful throughout the year.

inspiratieboek.label: Inspiration Book
inspiratieboek.tekst: During your personal Site Consultation, we bring along our Inspiration Book. Together we'll explore different planting styles, planters, materials and design ideas to create a planting concept that perfectly complements your interior and reflects your organisation.
inspiratieboek.fotoAlt: Open inspiration book with plant photography on an oak table, next to glaze samples, wood swatches and a fern in a terracotta pot

over.tekst1: We believe interior planting creates real value when every detail feels right. That's why we combine personal advice, quality plants, carefully selected planters and professional maintenance to create interiors that remain welcoming and beautifully presented for years to come.
over.tekst2: From offices and reception areas to professional practices and private residences, we create planting solutions that feel perfectly at home in every environment.
over.fotoAlt: Kentia palm in a light ceramic pot next to an oak desk, against a limewash wall

contact.label: Contact
contact.lede: Curious what interior planting could do for your business or home? We'd be delighted to visit you for a personal Site Consultation and bring along our Inspiration Book to explore the possibilities together.
contact.werkgebiedTekst: Based in Wassenaar, Blad & Vorm provides interior planting services for businesses and stylish homes throughout The Hague, Voorburg, Leidschendam, Voorschoten, Leiden, Oegstgeest, Warmond, Katwijk and Noordwijk.
